label: v78 evidence-corrected direct artist support-grasp silhouette r2

intent: One evidence-derived artist correction after checkpoint 35. The first v78 gesture visibly over-curled because each PIP/DIP reversed back left/down after its parent moved. This revision redraws each complete digit as one smooth right/down arc toward and behind the fixed vessel, with index least closed and pinky deepest, while substantially reducing camera-depth curl. It is one gesture, not a parameter sweep.

visual_gate.macro: At 192x108 first glance must read as a relaxed firm human bottle support grip, not a fist/claw or open hand.
visual_gate.meso: Unobstructed anatomy view must show four smooth separated digit arcs with progressive far-side wrap, no severe self-intersection or distal kinks, and the frozen v74 thumb must remain visibly opposing the four-finger side.
